de0_frame.topic: Preface: the executive order that created DOGE and the 2026 removal-power ruling

claims.text: EO 14158, signed 20 January 2025, established the Department of Government Efficiency to implement 'the President's DOGE Agenda' by modernizing federal technology and software; it renamed the US Digital Service the US DOGE Service and set the DOGE temporary organization to terminate on 4 July 2026.

Trump v. Slaughter, 29 June 2026, 6-3 (Roberts, C.J.; Sotomayor, Kagan, Jackson dissenting): Humphrey's Executor overruled; the FTC Act's for-cause removal protection is unconstitutional and the President may remove FTC commissioners at will. The Court left open offices traditionally outside the executive branch, naming the Federal Reserve; in Trump v. Cook the same day it denied the government's stay application.
